summary: Atlas Trinity Tech Limited, a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the resignation of CEO Tim Hoi Ching effective October 15, 2026, and the immediate appointment of Chairman Haoyuan Liu as CEO. Ching cited no disagreement with the company, management or board and asserted no claims beyond accrued compensation. Liu's employment agreement provides a US$150,000 annual salary; he has chaired the board since April 15, 2026, and previously held roles at GoFintech Quantum Innovation (0290.HK) and Trenda Investment. Watch for potential governance or strategy shifts given the combined chairman-CEO role and the abrupt leadership transition.
